entries.title: Job 5:1
segments: ¶"Call out now; Is there anyone who will answer you? And to which of the holy ones will you turn?

entries.title: Job 5:2
segments: For wrath kills a foolish man, And envy slays a simple one.

entries.title: Job 5:3
segments: I have seen the foolish taking root, But suddenly I cursed his dwelling place.

entries.title: Job 5:4
segments: His sons are far from safety, They are crushed in the gate, And [there is] no deliverer.

entries.title: Job 5:5
segments: Because the hungry eat up his harvest, Taking it even from the thorns, And a snare snatches their substance.

entries.title: Job 5:6
segments: ¶For affliction does not come from the dust, Nor does trouble spring from the ground;

entries.title: Job 5:7
segments: Yet man is born to trouble, As the sparks fly upward.

entries.title: Job 5:8
segments: "But as for me, I would seek God, And to God I would commit my cause-

entries.title: Job 5:9
segments: Who does great things, and unsearchable, Marvelous things without number.

entries.title: Job 5:10
segments: He gives rain on the earth, And sends waters on the fields.

entries.title: Job 5:11
segments: He sets on high those who are lowly, And those who mourn are lifted to safety.

entries.title: Job 5:12
segments: He frustrates the devices of the crafty, So that their hands cannot carry out their plans.

entries.title: Job 5:13
segments: He catches the wise in their own craftiness, And the counsel of the cunning comes quickly upon them.

entries.title: Job 5:14
segments: They meet with darkness in the daytime, And grope at noontime as in the night.

entries.title: Job 5:15
segments: But He saves the needy from the sword, From the mouth of the mighty, And from their hand.

entries.title: Job 5:16
segments: So the poor have hope, And injustice shuts her mouth.

entries.title: Job 5:17
segments: ¶"Behold, happy [is] the man whom God corrects; Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.

entries.title: Job 5:18
segments: For He bruises, but He binds up; He wounds, but His hands make whole.

entries.title: Job 5:19
segments: He shall deliver you in six troubles, Yes, in seven no evil shall touch you.

entries.title: Job 5:20
segments: In famine He shall redeem you from death, And in war from the power of the sword.

entries.title: Job 5:21
segments: You shall be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, And you shall not be afraid of destruction when it comes.

entries.title: Job 5:22
segments: You shall laugh at destruction and famine, And you shall not be afraid of the beasts of the earth.

entries.title: Job 5:23
segments: For you shall have a covenant with the stones of the field, And the beasts of the field shall be at peace with you.

entries.title: Job 5:24
segments: You shall know that your tent [is] in peace; You shall visit your dwelling and find nothing amiss.

entries.title: Job 5:25
segments: You shall also know that your descendants [shall be] many, And your offspring like the grass of the earth.

entries.title: Job 5:26
segments: You shall come to the grave at a full age, As a sheaf of grain ripens in its season.

entries.title: Job 5:27
segments: Behold, this we have searched out; It [is] true. Hear it, and know for yourself."
